en-GB.name: Hush: Don't Wake the Mimic
en-GB.subtitle: Open slowly. Steal the gold.
en-GB.description:
Your iPhone Duo is a treasure chest. The chest is a sleeping mimic.

The phone is the chest: shut is shut, and the chest opens with the phone from the first degrees. Open it slowly and the candlelight spills in, showing the gold. Drag the loot into your bag gently, then close the phone to bank it. Too fast, and the chest creaks, the mimic wakes, and it bites.

The game where you have to be gentle.

No ads. No in-app purchases. No accounts. No data collected. Pay once and it's yours.

THREE RULES
1. The chest opens with the phone. Move it slowly.
2. Drag the loot into your bag.
3. Close the phone to bank it before your candle runs out.
With the phone shut, the outer screen shows these rules and Play: press it, then open the phone slowly. Or open the phone and press Play inside. No lesson first: your first run is the real thing.

SLOW HANDS WIN
- Coins sit near the front, gems further back, and relics deep inside: open wide for those
- Drag gently: a fast drag rattles, and loot dropped outside the bag clunks
- Loot in your bag isn't safe yet: close the phone to bank it
- A bite costs everything in your bag and 10 seconds of candle

WATCH THE MIMIC
Every chest starts asleep. The noise meter on the chest floor fills when you move too fast and drains when you keep still. When the snoring stops, a slow heartbeat starts and the velvet tongue twitches, it's stirring. When the meter turns red and "Freeze!" appears, hold still and let it settle. Each mimic wears a name tag and has a habit: Snorers, Light Sleepers, Heavy Sleepers, and Dreamers who twitch in their sleep.

PUSH YOUR LUCK
Your candle burns down while you loot, and a flask of oil found in a chest buys six more seconds. Bank, and the next chest is waiting, closed: open the phone again for it. The chests get richer as you go, from Wooden to Iron-bound, Gilded and Royal. When something glints deeper in, a relic is hiding at the back: open wider, or bank what you have? When the candle goes out the run ends, and anything still in your bag is lost.

HUSH CHAIN AND GOLDEN MIMICS
Bank a chest without the mimic ever stirring and it's Hushed. Hushed banks in a row build a Hush Chain, and each one pays more: gold ×1.1, ×1.2, up to ×1.5. One stir breaks the chain. Now and then a golden mimic turns up: it doubles a chest's gold, but it sleeps lighter.

DAILY DUNGEON
The same chests for everyone, every day, and one try that counts. Then practise as much as you like.

RELICS AND THIEF RANKS
Twenty-four named relics hide deep in the better chests, from the Moth-Eaten Crown to the Idol of the Sleepy God. Each one you find stays in your Relic Codex. Every coin you bank counts towards your thief rank: twelve ranks, from Pickpocket to Mimic Whisperer.

MADE FOR THE FOLD. PLAYS ON EVERY iPhone.
On iPhone Duo the hinge is the chest, and how gently you move it is the whole skill. No pose to hold, never flat, never fast: moving fast is how you lose. Close the phone and the chest closes: your bag is banked and your candle waits. iPhone Duo softens one half of its screen for a moment when a fold starts, so Hush keeps the loot, the noise meter and every warning on the half that stays sharp. On any other iPhone, an on-screen lever opens and closes the chest. Same chests, same mimic, same leaderboards.

SOUND AND FEEL
The creak follows your exact speed, in sound and in haptics. The snores, the heartbeat, the coin clinks, the cascade of a banked haul and the CHOMP are all synthesised live in the app. Every warning is shown on screen too, so you can play with the sound off. Sound plays on silent unless you switch that off. Settings has Sound, Vibration, Lid sensitivity (Forgiving, for shaky hands) and Reduce motion, and replays First Chest, a short lesson, any time.

GAME CENTER
Leaderboards for your Best Haul and the Daily Dungeon, and 12 achievements. Optional: Hush works fully without it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No tracking. Your progress stays on your iPhone.

review.notes:
Thanks for reviewing Hush: a paid game. No login or accounts, no in-app purchases, no ads, no data collected, and no network requests of its own. Game Center is optional.

THE WHOLE GAME: THREE RULES (shown in the app before you play)
iPhone Duo: 1 The chest opens with the phone. Move it slowly. 2 Drag the loot into your bag. 3 Close the phone to bank it before your candle runs out.
Other iPhones: 1 The chest opens with the lever. Slide it up slowly. 2 Drag the loot into your bag. 3 Slide the lever down to bank it before your candle runs out.
Moving fast makes noise. If the noise meter fills, the mimic wakes: "Freeze!" means keep still and it settles; if not, it bites (CHOMP): the bag is lost and the 100 s candle loses 10 s. First launch opens Home; Play is a real run. First Chest is only an optional replay (Settings > Replay First Chest).

1. ANY iPHONE OR THE SIMULATOR (start here)
The full game works on any iPhone and in the Simulator, in portrait. The top half has an on-screen brass LEVER; the bottom half is the floor with the loot.
- Press Play. Slide the lever up slowly: the chest opens with the lever and the lit loot appears.
- Drag a lit coin or gem into the bag (IN BAG).
- Slide the lever down: the bag is banked (BANKED). The next chest waits, closed: slide the lever up again.
- Tap the round pause coin to pause.
Every mode and achievement works with the lever.

2. iPHONE DUO (the hinge)
The phone IS the chest: 0 degrees shut, 150 wide, openness = angle / 150. At 15 degrees or less it counts as shut. No pose to hold, no lever, no pose tip.
a) Phone shut: the outer screen shows an intro ("Steal the mimic's gold while it sleeps", the three rules, Play, "Press Play, then open the phone slowly"). Press Play, then open the phone: the chest opens with the phone.
b) Launched with the phone open: press Play on the inner screen and the run starts with the chest already open.
c) Close the phone to bank. With loot in the bag the close IS the bank, at any speed; with an empty bag it just ends that chest. After a bank the outer screen shows "Banked +N gold!" and "Open the phone slowly for the next chest" (after an empty chest: "Open the phone slowly"); the candle waits while shut, and End run is there. Opening again (play resumes from about 18 degrees) brings the next chest.
d) PAUSE on the inner screen: press and hold the pause coin (a tap shows "Hold to pause").
e) NEVER STUCK: Home is always on the pause card; Carry on appears after 3 s. If the hinge has not reported yet, the card says "Move the phone a little" (with Home). On the outer screen, "Already open?" does the same if the phone is open.
f) There is no "Hold still" card and no "That's wide enough".
Hush reads the hinge angle only through the public iOS 27.1 API (SwiftUI onHingeChange), behind an availability check; never the hinge's closed status. The angle never leaves the phone.

3. KIND TO THE DEVICE (2.4.2, 1.4.5)
Fast opening is the losing move. Play is the phone's ordinary open and close (the app does ask the player to close the phone to bank); never flat, never fast, and nothing rewards hinge speed or move count.

4. MODES AND SETTINGS
Run; Daily Dungeon (same chests for everyone each UTC day, one scored try); First Chest (optional replay). 12 achievements, 2 leaderboards. Settings: Sound, Vibration (Off, Normal, Strong), Lid sensitivity (Forgiving, Normal, Strict; the scored Daily plays Normal), Play sound on silent, Reduce motion. Settings > About has Privacy and Support links.

5. CONTENT (9+)
A cartoon chest mimic "bites" a noisy player: a comic CHOMP and a red flash. Nobody is hurt.

6. OTHER
No SDKs, analytics, notifications or rating prompt; Data Not Collected. Debug and demo modes are compiled out of Release. Diagnostic log: Settings > About > hold the Version line 2 s > Copy log. It stays on the device; nothing is sent. All sound is synthesized; every sound cue has an on-screen cue.

nomination.name: Hush - App Launch - iPhone Duo hinge-speed stealth
nomination.description:
Hush turns iPhone Duo into a treasure chest, and the chest is a sleeping mimic. The phone is the chest: it opens with the phone. Open it slowly and candlelight spills in to show the gold; drag the loot into your bag gently, then close the phone to bank it. Too fast, and the chest creaks, the mimic wakes and it bites.

It is the first game we know of that scores how slowly you move the hinge. The creak in your speaker and your fingers follows your speed exactly, so being gentle is the whole challenge, and the losing move is the one that is hard on a hinge.

Push-your-luck runs of about two minutes against a burning candle, chests that get richer from Wooden to Royal, golden mimics worth double, a Hush Chain that pays more for sleepy banks in a row, a Daily Dungeon with the same chests for everyone, a 24-relic Codex and Game Center. Every other iPhone plays with an on-screen lever. No ads, no in-app purchases, no data collected.
nomination.notes: Optimized for iPhone Duo: the hinge maps literally to the chest, so there is no pose to learn. Phone shut, the outer screen shows three rules and Play: press Play, open the phone slowly, close it to bank. No forced tutorial (an optional lesson is in Settings). iOS blurs one half of the screen when a fold starts, so loot and warnings stay on the sharp half. Public iOS 27.1 hinge API; never asks for flat or fast. All sound synthesized. Also from us: Squish, Brim and Swoop.
